content:
Data aggregation and filtering logic errors caused mismatches in Excel summary counts and missing values in the Word executive summary.
The test_formatted_data_logic failed when a 'Missing Final Event' value was 0 instead of 1, indicating flawed grouping by (Return ID, Line ID). Summary sheet validation failed with a count of 1 vs expected 6, suggesting the 'Total Errors > 0' filter or Grand Total calculation is incorrect. Word output lacked the required 'Grand Total' value of 12 in the executive summary text. Disposition_Alias.xlsx mapping must be verified for case-insensitive standard name conversion.
